subject: LedgerPay feature queue petition — activation path & audit-export requirements
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: LedgerPay feature queue petition — activation path & audit-export requirements

Team —

Quick ask: LedgerPay (large payments SaaS, go-live target 10/01) surfaced two gating items in procurement that block activation unless we can commit to a short-term delivery path:

1) Tenant-level audit-export (per-tenant log export on demand, S3 CSV bundle) — compliance says they need up to 30 days of historical event exports at activation.
2) Stronger tenant isolation controls for routing (must guarantee routing to dedicated pool or a tenant affinity model while we finish policy-based isolation later).

I attached the customer audit requirements and the mutual action plan we shared. Amanda (procurement) is asking for a one-page delivery plan they can present to their security board by Friday.

Asks:
- Can Product/Eng commit to a phased delivery: (A) on-demand audit-export + manual support process for first 90 days, (B) automated export + simple UI in next quarter?
- Is there a low-effort routing shim (tenant tag -> affinity lane) we can expose as an internal config now to satisfy their isolation ask?

If we can agree on minimal scope, I can convert this into a single-slide MOA and share with LedgerPay leadership. This deal is $1.1M ARR, strong reference potential.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: LedgerPay_Audit-Reqs_v2.pdf, LP_MutualActionPlan.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerPay feature queue petition — activation path & audit-export requirements

Thanks for the context, Naomi. Quick notes from Product: we hear the ask and want to minimize scope while keeping operational risk low. A few clarifying questions before I commit a timeline:

- Audit-export: do they require a REST API to trigger exports, or is a ticketed export (we run it and place in their S3) acceptable for the first 90 days? The technical effort differs substantially.
- Export format: CSV of event stream (need the sample schema) vs. parquet. The attached PDF references CSV but not the exact schema.
- Routing shim: we already have a short-lived affinity flag used in Dedicated pilots. Engineering (cc Marissa) estimates 2–3 sprints to harden it into a config route for Hosted customers, but we need to understand SLA and scale requirements.

If procurement needs a one-page plan by Friday, I can draft an acceptance criteria + phased timeline today if someone confirms the export trigger option (API vs manual) and the expected export size/retention.

I’ll wait for the answers and can propose a minimal MVP timeline (target: export-by-ticket + affinity config by EOW, full automation next quarter) if that fits.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Group PM, Enterprise Features
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerPay feature queue petition — activation path & audit-export requirements

Irene —

Amanda replied to the MA Plan thread and confirmed the following this morning (pasted):

"We need the ability to request an export of activity logs for a tenant going back 30 days. For go-live, a manual export run by your team placed into our S3 with a predictable delivery SLA is acceptable. For Q4 we would need an API-based export. Also, tenant traffic must be routable to an isolated lane — they prefer tenant affinity to a dedicated pool but will accept a stronger affinity guarantee as an interim."

So they explicitly accept a manual export for activation. They asked that we provide a one-page plan with: owner for export runs, expected delivery SLA (hours), rollback/retention notes, and a short timeline to automation.

Operational notes:
- Estimated export size: 5–12 GB compressed for 30 days (their volume).
- They want export SLA <= 6 hours for manual runs at activation window.

If Product can sign off on a manual export + affinity config for go-live, Sales + CS can agree to limited credits and a short-term operational playbook (Priyom, can you confirm team availability for manual runs?).

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerPay feature queue petition — activation path & audit-export requirements

All —

CS can own the manual export process for the initial 90-day window. Confirmed availability from the on-call operations pool. Proposed playbook (high level):

- Owner: CS Ops (Priyom) — runbook and escalation path documented in Confluence.
- SLA: initial target 4 hours for export delivery to customer S3 (will commit 6 hours formally in the one-pager).
- Security: exports uploaded to their pre-approved S3 bucket using presigned URLs; files encrypted (AES-256).
- Rollout: enable affinity tag via routing shim; CS to validate routing with LedgerPay during the staging week (9/15–9/21).

Irene — if Product can approve the routing shim and confirm the export schema (CSV columns) I’ll assemble the one-page plan and hand it off to Naomi to share with Amanda by Friday.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
